## Hinge question {#gac2-hinge .gac-lesson}

<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="2" class="hinge numeric-choices gac2-hinge">
<p class="hinge-question">Given <span data-math="f'(x)=3x^2+2x"></span>, what is <span data-math="f''(1)"></span>?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="5"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="8"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="6"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="0"></span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>2.</strong> Differentiate first: <span data-math="f''(x)=6x+2"></span>.<br>Then evaluate: <span data-math="f''(1)=8"></span>.</div>
</div>

::: notes
Additional diagnostic, 4 minutes including response. Correct choice 2: the supplied expression is already f'(x). Differentiate it once to obtain f''(x)=6x+2, then substitute x=1 to obtain 8.

Choice 1 (5): evaluates f'(1), stopping before the requested differentiation.
Choice 3 (6): differentiates the supplied first derivative twice, obtaining 6x+2 then 6. This finds the third derivative rather than the requested second derivative.
Choice 4 (0): substitutes x=1 first, then differentiates the resulting constant 5, losing the derivative function's dependence on x.

Use the shared 60-second adjustable timer and collect simultaneous 1–4 finger responses on the teacher's "show" cue. Do not reveal on timer expiry. Answer reveal is a separate button; Reset restores the chosen duration, clears choices and hides the explanation.

Ready: ask one student to explain the order of operations, then Example 1.6.
Divided: compare paired reasons for 30 seconds, then revote before revealing.
Needs explanation: distinguish the function f'(x) from the single number f'(1), revisit the notation slide, then recheck the same question.

Craig Barton, diagnostic questions: individual thinking, simultaneous responses and a response to the revealed misconception. https://tipsforteachers.co.uk/diagnostic-questions/ .
:::
